title: Horava Stars Revisited: New Phases of Incompressible Stars and Black Holes, and Buchdahl's Theorem
summary: I study a particular exact solution for static stars in four-dimensional non-projectable Horava gravity, which has been proposed as a renormalizable gravity model without the ghost problem by abandoning Einstein's equal-footing treatment of space and time through anisotropic scaling with z > 1.
